pass1.sentence: A thin tube with a camera, called a cystoscope, is passed along the urethra, the tube that carries urine out of the body, and into the bladder.
pass1.note: Search summary of NHS and trust pages: two types, flexible (thin flexible tube with camera) and rigid (straight non-bending); flexible often for checking symptoms, rigid often to treat. Urethra definition is textbook.

pass1.sentence: Trust leaflets say a flexible cystoscopy can help investigate symptoms such as blood in the urine, repeated urine infections, abdominal pain, loss of bladder control and an overactive bladder.
pass1.note: Summary of trust leaflets: blood in urine, recurrent UTIs, abdominal pain, loss of bladder control/overactive bladder; biopsies; Botox for overactive bladder. Biopsy definition textbook.

pass1.sentence: It also lets clinicians take biopsies, which are small pieces of tissue sent for testing, and give Botox injections to relax the bladder in overactive bladder.
pass1.note: Summary of trust leaflets: blood in urine, recurrent UTIs, abdominal pain, loss of bladder control/overactive bladder; biopsies; Botox for overactive bladder. Biopsy definition textbook.

pass1.sentence: A flexible cystoscopy is usually done under local anaesthetic, with a numbing gel, and does not need a general anaesthetic.
pass1.note: Summary: flexible usually local, no GA; rigid under general anaesthetic, spinal also possible, usually told to avoid eating/drinking several hours beforehand.

pass1.sentence: A rigid cystoscopy is done under general anaesthetic, which means being asleep.
